$comment: Team-shared Claude Code settings for openclaw-nodedev. Personal overrides go in settings.local.json. Gates (MASTER_PLAN §6.2, remediation Phase 3): scope-check.sh gates every Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit against the active plan scopes (memory-plan/plans/*/SCOPE.md, open ```files blocks only); validate-commit.sh scans staged files for secrets/JSON validity before `git commit`; validate-push.sh refuses force pushes. The same two validators also run as git hooks (config/git-hooks via core.hooksPath, installed by `npm prepare`), so they hold for any tool, not only Claude Code. The deny list below makes validate-push.sh's refusal true at the permission layer too (prefix rules only: a force flag placed later in the command is caught by the hook).
